feedback.markdownBody:
VERIFICATION FAILED for PAN-5522 (attempt 1/3):

Failed check: vbrief-ac

Acceptance criteria check FAILED — 12/12 AC incomplete:

### Register gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol in the capability, class, fallback, provider and settings tables (2/2 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given MODEL_CAPABILITIES, when gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol are read, then each has the openai provider, contextWindow 272000, effort levels low/medium/high/xhigh/max and capability class frontier, as model-capabilities.test.ts asserts.
  - [ ] Given the settings model catalog API, when it lists OpenAI models, then gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol are the first two entries, as settings-model-catalog.test.ts asserts.

### Price gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol from the 2026-11-18 OpenAI pricing page (2/2 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given getPricing, when called for openai gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol, then it returns the row for that exact model with the published input, cached and output prices, as cost.test.ts asserts.
  - [ ] Given src/lib/cost.ts, when read, then the 6.2 rows cite developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (checked 2026-11-18) and state that the price tier above 272K is not modeled.

### Set the Codex ChatGPT sign-in floor for both models to 0.170.0 (2/2 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given a ChatGPT sign-in and Codex CLI 0.169.0, when canUseHarness checks either 6.2 model on the codex harness, then it refuses and names 0.170.0; at 0.170.0 or with api-key auth it allows the launch, as harness-policy.test.ts asserts.
  - [ ] Given pan doctor, when checkCodexModelFloors runs, then it returns six floor rows including both 6.2 models, as doctor-codex-models.test.ts asserts.

### Pin both models to 272K on the claude-code CLIProxy route (2/2 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given getClaudeCodeContextPolicyForModel, when called for gpt-6.2-astra or gpt-6.2-sol, then it exports the same 272K window as the capability table, as the model-capabilities.test.ts harness-env case asserts.
  - [ ] Given src/lib/cliproxy.ts, when read, then a comment records the 2026-11-18 probe of v8.0.71 (both models listed and served), and CLIPROXY_RELEASE_VERSION stays v8.0.71.

### Show both models in the Settings catalog, model picker and friendly names (2/2 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given getFriendlyModelName, when called with gpt-6.2-astra or gpt-6.2-sol, then it returns GPT-6.2 Astra or GPT-6.2 Sol, as dashboard-utils.test.ts asserts.
  - [ ] Given the frontend MODELS_BY_PROVIDER openai list and the ModelPicker OpenAI fallback group, when read, then both list gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol first, with costPer1MTokens 24 and 6.

### Document both models and add the changelog entry (2/2 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given configuration/harnesses.mdx, when read, then it names gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol with their prices, the 0.170.0 Codex floor and the 2026-11-18 CLIProxy probe.
  - [ ] Given changelog.d/pan-5522.md, when npm run lint:docs runs, then it passes with one New bullet for the two models.

## REQUIRED: Complete all acceptance criteria BEFORE resubmitting

1. Review the incomplete AC above
2. Implement the missing requirements and write tests
3. Close every completed task with `pan task close` — the canonical writer publishes the close and AC statuses sync automatically; never hand-edit spec files
4. Commit and push ALL changes
5. ONLY THEN resubmit: pan review request PAN-5522 -m "Completed acceptance criteria"

Do NOT resubmit until all AC are completed.
